name: Slumberbolt · Gremlet #43
description:
An armoured machine that curled up for a nap a century ago. Moss thinks it's a rock.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Slumberbolt in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
